schema.gate.fallback.hilfe: Only used when the gate does not exist at all or reports unavailable, and only for the question “on or off”. Without it the renderer would never come back after losing its segments. Sending still waits for the gate itself to answer — otherwise Aton would write into the device's boot time
schema.gate.fallback.label: Fallback
schema.gate.wartezeit.hilfe: Nothing is sent until the gate reports “on”: HA sets it exactly when it talks to the device. This is how long to wait before trying anyway — that single attempt is what resolves a segment loss. Measured boot times ranged from 18 to 95 s
schema.gate.wartezeit.label: Wait for the gate

ui.ausserhalb_bereich: ⚠ Moved — the tile sits outside the screen group's region (%s). It is drawn, but not exchanged when the screen changes.
ui.ausserhalb_flaeche: ⚠ Moved — but the tile now sits outside the panel area (%s). It will not be drawn until position or size fit.
ui.beschreibung_fehlerhaft: The description is invalid — nothing is being drawn.
ui.beschreibung_fehlerhaft_hilfe: Fix it on the Configuration tab, then Reload. The app does not need a restart for that.
ui.datei_extern_geaendert: The file was changed outside the configurator. Reload and discard your changes?
ui.einlesen_abgelehnt: Rejected — the description has an error. The panels keep running with the previous one.
ui.einlesen_hilfe: Re-read the description, fonts, icons and your own widget types from /config/aton_widgets. Manual selection and running notifications reset.
ui.in_kachel_umwandeln_hilfe: Rewrites the block as a `type: notify` tile. The message line can then be dragged in the preview like any other tile.
ui.keine_auswahl: Nothing selected — pick something on the left, or click a tile in the preview.
ui.namen_beim_speichern: Outdated names — will be rewritten when you save:
ui.schrift_unbekannt: The app does not know this font — typo or missing file.
ui.schriften_hilfe: These are not the fonts themselves but rules per font. A font is picked in the defaults or on a tile.
ui.schriften_leer: No entry — every font uses its built-in rules.
ui.stand: Build of this page: app version · modification time
ui.ungespeichert_neu_laden: There are unsaved changes. Reload anyway?
ui.veraltet: The browser is running {browser}, the server serves {server} — what you see may be out of date.
ui.vollbild_hilfe: Rewrite the whole surface — helps when the matrix shows something the app did not draw
ui.ziehen_hinweis: Click a tile to edit it, drag to move it. Grid tiles snap to cells.
